moodys.citation_text: Moody's 2024-02-27 rating action: 'Moody's upgrades CommonSpirit Health's revenue bonds to A3 [from Baa1]' — implying pre-action rating was Baa1. CommonSpirit at Baa1/Stable on 2022-12-31 consistent with multi-year holding.

sp.citation_text: Per CommonSpirit investor resources page, S&P maintained at BBB+ through 2023, then upgraded to A- in 2024-2025 cycle. PARTIALLY VERIFIED — exact starting S&P notch inferred from chronology.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch BBB+ in effect at start of window per CommonSpirit investor materials.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Upgraded revenue bonds to A3 from Baa1; assigned A3 to Series 2024 $2.8B bonds; outlook stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Achieved operational and organizational integration goals from CHI-Dignity merger; improved performance.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: 'Moody's upgraded CommonSpirit Health to A3 from Baa1 on February 27, 2024, and concurrently assigned an A3 to the proposed $2.8 billion Series 2024 bonds.'
Per CommonSpirit investor resources, S&P moved to A- following Moody's upgrade in 2024.
Fitch tracked S&P/Moody's upgrade to A- stable in 2024.

moodys.citation_text: A3/Stable in effect post-Feb 2024 upgrade and remained at window end.

sp.citation_text: S&P A-/Stable confirmed by Sept 2025 affirmation: 'S&P Global Ratings affirmed CommonSpirit Health's credit rating of A- with a stable outlook' on Sept 26, 2025.

outcome_class_rationale: All three agencies upgraded CommonSpirit Health during the window: Moody's Baa1 -> A3 (one notch, Feb 27, 2024); S&P BBB+ -> A- (one notch, 2024); Fitch BBB+ -> A- (one notch, 2024). UPGRADE.
